dataset_name: LA28 Olympic Games Competition Schedule - Detailed Sessions
notes: Primary structured extraction source is the Competition Schedule by Event PDF.
Medal annotations are explicit where the session description names Bronze Medal or Gold Medal contests.

For sessions marked Final without explicit Bronze/Gold wording, inferred_gold_medal_session=true indicates a likely medal-awarding final session, but this is an inference rather than explicit PDF wording.
Football (Soccer) sessions with TBD start/end remain unscheduled in this export.
Some OKC venue sessions are listed in local Central Time in the source PDF and are preserved as CT.

venues: Comcast Squash Center at Universal Studios
